extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors / contributors trying to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article (here: the title 'Comedy book'), including account requirements, searching for existing coverage, and technical/administrative checks. Focused on procedural steps to add or recover an encyclopedia page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only autoconfirmed users may create pages directly; if you cannot create the page because you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed, consider alternative submission routes (article wizard, request pages) or create an account and reach autoconfirmed status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create a live article immediately (e.g., new users, uncertain notability), submit a draft through the article wizard or follow Wikipedia's 'request a new article' procedures so experienced editors can review and assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Comedy book' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, thoroughly search Wikipedia for existing coverage under similar or variant titles to avoid duplication; consider alternative spellings, synonyms, and broader or narrower topic pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use link searches to find incoming links which may indicate existing coverage under a different title or show where a redirect would be useful; examining linking pages can reveal appropriate article placement or needed redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay or caching may hide recently created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created page does not appear, wait briefly and retry or use the purge function to refresh caches before assuming the page is absent or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify correct capitalization and common variants; if the desired title is better represented under another capitalization or phrasing, create a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a title you expect is missing, consult the deletion log and documentation on deletions to understand reasons (notability, copyright, etc.) and whether recreation is appropriate or requires addressing deletion causes first.
